policy: Optional add-ons are never installed or activated by install.zsh. Use addons.zsh with an explicit add-on ID.

addons.name: OpenCodex
addons.warning: Third-party provider router. Initialization can rewrite Codex provider configuration; review provider terms and authorize activation separately.

addons.name: CodexBar
addons.warning: Optional macOS usage-limit and status monitor. Review its local-file, Keychain, browser-cookie, and provider-access behavior before enabling integrations.

consideredNotIncluded.reason: Its agents, hooks, workflows, and configuration merging substantially overlap this kit and Compound Engineering.
